remarks: First time on the market. Builders own home, only the best construction from the highest level of professional contractor. Brick and stone build quality. Effortless one-level living on a coveted 1.01-acre lot, minutes from the heart of New Canaan. This meticulously maintained 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers the single-floor lifestyle today's buyers crave - with expansion potential to grow into a larger home. Gracious principal rooms flow to a manicured, level yard that offers privacy and space to garden, entertain, or simply unwind. A full finished basement adds flexible room for a media room, gym, or home office, while the attached 2-car garage handles everyday ease. All just moments from town, train, shops, and dining - a turnkey opportunity for downsizers and growing households alike, in one of Fairfield County's most sought-after towns.
